India loses ODI series after middle-order collapse; England wins second match

England leveled the ODI series against India by winning the second match. Indian captain Shubman Gill attributed the defeat to a "middle-order choke" and losing too many wickets. England's Joe Root stated the team is "learning on the job" in ODIs. Separately, England defeated Argentina 31-26 in a rugby match marked by seven yellow cards. Several upcoming cricket matches were also listed, including AUT vs ISR, BUL vs IOM, ISR vs ROM, IRE vs AFG, FRA vs AUT, NOI vs KAN, and TUR vs ISR.
